UTAH
Under authority of the act of Congress approved June 25, 1910 (36 -Stat.,
847), as amended by the act of August 24, 1912 (37 Stat.,p 497), it is hereby ordered
that the public lands in the following described area in Utah be, and the same are
hereby, temporarily withdrawn subject to the conditions, provisions and limitations
of said acts, for the purpose of classifying such lands and pending enactment of
appropriate legislation for their proper disposition:
Salt Lake Meridian
In unsurveyed T. 42 S., R. 93 W., what will probably be when surveyed
Secs. 5, 6, 7, and 8;
In T. 42 S., R. 10 W., SW4 Sec. 3, NW/ Sec. 10, and unsurveyed land which
will probably be when surveyed all Secs. .1 and 2, N32 and SE5 Sec. 3, NEY and
S5. Sec. 10, all Sees. 11 and 12.
CALVIN COOLIDGE
THE Wmm Housu,
March, 24, 1925.
[No. 4181]
